verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS work-management product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a public API, a published OpenAPI spec, an MCP server and third-party integrations (such as n8n's fair-code tool). None of these is ClickUp's own source code under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
